notes.title: Dummy Guyz Update 20240628
notes.notes:
Hello Players,

We have updated our game to support Steam Workshop, allowing you to create and use mods in Dummy Guyz. I've recorded a brief demonstration video to show you how to create content in Unity.

Unity Project
https://github.com/DummyGuyz/DummyGuyz-SteamWork


Demonstration Video
[previewyoutube=L8GPd9Hu5qY;full][/previewyoutube]

After creating your content, you can use the Publish Tool located in the game folder to upload it to Steam.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036942/9a814797760e760ea1707e8c294d2b945bfb0265.png

How to Subscribe and Unsubscribe?
Simply open the Steam Workshop, select the content you want, and subscribe.

How to Install and Uninstall Steam Workshop Content?
Currently, in-game loading of Workshop content is not supported. To ensure proper loading, you need to return to the main menu when subscribing or unsubscribing.

Why is the content different when I play with my friends?
We do not yet support auto-loading based on the host's subscriptions. If you play with friends, please make sure you all have the same Workshop subscriptions.

Enjoy the new modding capabilities, and we look forward to seeing your creations!
